title: Compiling Rust to readable C with Eurydice
summary: Eurydice is a Rust compiler backend that transpiles Rust code into readable C, enabling Rust programs to run on platforms without native Rust toolchain support while maintaining interoperability with existing C codebases.
problem_solved: Enables running Rust code in C-centric environments and on platforms lacking Rust toolchain support.
why_valuable: Provides a bridge between Rust's memory safety guarantees and C's portability, making Rust more accessible for embedded systems and cross-platform development.
